title: Let’s Meet at Snowflake Summit 2025 + Our Exclusive Yacht Sunset Cruise
summary: Etleap streamlines data ingestion, transformation, and observability so your team can create data products effortlessly.
body_markdown:
## **🌟 See What’s New From Etleap at Snowflake Summit**


We’re excited to announce that **Etleap will be at Snowflake Summit 2025** , taking place June 2–5 in San Francisco! Join us at **Booth #1411** to connect with our team, explore our modern approach to data pipelines, and get a demo of **something brand new we’re very excited to unveil at the show!**


If you're attending the Summit and looking to simplify your data stack and accelerate your analytics, you won’t want to miss it.


-


**🖥️ Hands-on demos** of how Etleap simplifies complex data pipelines


-


**🤝 1:1 sessions** with our Solutions Architects (bring your toughest questions)


-


**🐆 Cheetah sightings** — yes, the stuffed kind. If you know, you know.


📍 **Booth #1411 — we can’t wait to see you there!**


## **🎊 Celebrate With Us: Etleap Sunset Cruise on the Bay**


After a day of insight-packed sessions, unwind with us at our exclusive **Sunset Cruise** aboard the elegant *Just Dreaming* yacht.


-


**📅 Date:** Wednesday, June 4


-


**🕔 Time:** 5:00 PM - 8:30 PM


-


**📍 Location:** Walking distance from Moscone Center *(boarding info shared with confirmed guests)*


-


**🍽️ Includes:** Hosted bar, gourmet catering, and Golden Gate views


**Space is limited — inquire about open spots by emailing**info@etleap.com


[About the yacht →](https://justdreamingyacht.com/)


## **🤝 Let’s Connect at Snowflake Summit**


Whether you’re transforming your data stack, exploring AI workflows, or looking to simplify pipelines — **Etleap at Booth #1411** is your first stop.


And don’t forget to RSVP for our **Yacht Sunset Cruise on June 4** — a perfect way to wrap up the day with peers, food, drinks, and unforgettable views.
